decoded_programs.fragment_difference: The second fragment variant discards samples whose alpha is below 1/255 before applying the same RGB transfer.

source.tone_mapping: No exposure, filmic curve, ACES transform, LUT, or color matrix occurs in the decoded gamma-correction fragment programs.

pixel_relation.candidate_ranking: Resource 68469 is the only exported 1280x720 target close to resource 68630 under the decoded sRGB transfer; every other candidate has mean absolute error above 57 bytes.
pixel_relation.boundary: The capture is an Eden Vulkan translation rather than a direct guest command stream, so the image-pair measurement supports the decoded source operation but is not claimed as a guest event-to-event trace.

implementation.scene_color_target: RGBA8 UNORM, matching the captured four-byte-per-pixel pre-gamma scene target class.
implementation.operation: Compose opaque and blended world content into the shared linear UNORM scene target, then apply the decoded standard sRGB transfer once with alpha passed through.
implementation.removed_invention: The generic engine ACES filmic curve and 1.15 viewer exposure no longer alter LGPE environment material modes.
implementation.preserved_boundary: Generic engine PBR materials retain their existing selectable tone-mapping path.
implementation.staging_boundary: IRenderBackendWorld now brackets complete 3D world composition. OpenGL, D3D12, Vulkan direct, and Vulkan indirect return linear world color while that pass is active; each backend applies the recovered equation once after composition and before display-space UI.

capture_tooling.purpose: Inventory low-index fullscreen RenderDoc draws, shaders, constant blocks, read-only resources, and outputs without treating Eden presentation copies as guest post stages.

route1_fog_boundary.implementation: No fog is applied to Route 1. The decoded fog programs are retained as evidence for maps or conditions that actually dispatch them.

subsequent_resolutions: The shared projected-depth matrix and native ten-tap PCF are resolved by route1_shared_projected_lighting_report.json.
The exact capture-backed tree001/tree002 runtime lightColor uploads are resolved by route1_field_tree_shader05_report.json.
open_boundaries: Fog behavior for maps or runtime conditions other than captured Route 1 remains unimplemented until an activating capture identifies the selected variant and constants.
